title: Open Endings (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Best Ensemble Performance, Cinemalaya Independent Film Festival

Queer East Festival

 

Hong Kong Premiere

 

Hannah, Mihan, Charlie, and Kit, these four queer women in their 30s,  have dated one another at different points in their lives. Now living together as a chosen family, they consider their bonds to have evolved into deep, familial love, promising to face the challenges of early adulthood together. However, a bombshell dropped by Hannah uncovers everyone’s unresolved relationship issues to resurface.

 

Remaining friends after a breakup, or being part of a large yet long-invisible bisexual community, this household reflects the diverse faces of today’s queer women. Whether it is friendship, sisterhood, family, or romance, you are all on your own to decide if it is an ending or just a temporary pause.
cast: Janella Salvador, Jasmine Curtis-Smith, Klea Pineda, Leanne Mamonong
